name: W2 leak / the gate 1 score IS the blind years
what: l2sweep.score_combo scores a combination on W2 + W3 pooled, i.e. 2011-01-01 to 2020-12-31. Those are every year Layer 2 later reported as out of sample. The survivors were chosen on the years their record was then quoted on, so the gate 1 verdict and the blind record are the same measurement twice.

name: mode contamination -- two exits on at once
touches_gate1: the FIRST sweep only; the three-mode rerun fixed it
what: the original sweep ran the exit indicator and the baseline cross simultaneously with the C1-flip exit off, so every combination was testing "whichever of two exits fires first". Measured on the instrumented run the baseline cross took 44% of trend closes against the exit indicator's 7%. gate1_survivors_v1.csv is that run.

name: field sight of 2016-2020
what: W3 = 2016-2020 is inside the gate 1 score, so the candidate FIELD handed to every later stage was selected with sight of the years those stages treated as unseen. This is the same defect as #1 seen from the field's side rather than the score's.

name: costs under-charged by atr_mult
touches_gate1: NO at gate 1, YES everywhere downstream
what: _cost_R returns the cost in RAW r units; when r is restated against a fixed 1.0xATR risk unit the cost has to be restated with it. Gate 1 runs every combination at atr_mult=1.0, so the factor is exactly 1.0 and the gate 1 numbers are unaffected -- but every tuned stage that moved the stop was under-charged, median 20%, p90 46%.

name: vote timing (the Book look-ahead)
what: gate 1 never nets. It aggregates per-combination R, so VOTE_ON_ENTRY_DAY has nothing to act on. The defect is real and fatal, but it enters at the Book, not here -- which is why the gate 1 survivor counts survived the vote-timing fix unchanged while every book number went negative.

name: costs off entirely
what: S.COSTS is None unless load_costs() is called. The gate 1 files on disk were produced before the costed path existed -- "Layer 2 charged NO costs at all before this: gates 1-3 to date are gross figures" (l2sweep.py). The honest gate 1 charges cost_table_h22 on every trade.
